note: Council-reviewed normalization manifest for QuillMD round-trip fidelity. Anything listed here MAY normalize on save, justified per entry. Anything NOT listed must round-trip byte-exactly. Changes to this manifest require a council round + Bruce sign-off (they change the product promise). Initial entries are implemented defaults from council round 1 — Bruce can veto any entry with one word.

manifest.behavior: May be re-inlined to [foo](url) on save when the edited block touches them
manifest.justification: Reference definitions are unrepresentable as PM inline nodes; re-inlining is the standard MD-editor normalization
manifest.user_visible: Reference-style links become inline-style after editing that block

manifest.behavior: Stored as opaque verbatim leaf node; preserved byte-exactly unless the user edits inside it
manifest.justification: HTML with embedded markdown cannot round-trip through a PM schema; opaque leaf prevents silent mutation
manifest.user_visible: HTML blocks are read-only regions in WYSIWYG; edit them in Source mode

manifest.behavior: List tightness may normalize to the document's dominant style when a list block is re-serialized
manifest.justification: PM list model loses the tight/loose distinction; preserving it requires custom node serialization per list
manifest.user_visible: Blank lines between list items may be added/removed after editing that list

manifest.behavior: May be converted to fenced code blocks (```) when the block is edited
manifest.justification: Indented code has ambiguous boundaries with lists; fenced is the canonical PM representation
manifest.user_visible: 4-space-indented code becomes fenced code after editing

manifest.behavior: Two-space hard breaks may normalize to backslash breaks (\\) or vice versa within edited blocks
manifest.justification: Multiple hard-break syntaxes exist in CommonMark; the serializer picks one canonical form
manifest.user_visible: Hard break style may change after editing that paragraph

manifest.behavior: Setext headings may normalize to ATX (#) form when edited
manifest.justification: PM heading node serializes to ATX; setext is preserved only in untouched blocks

manifest.behavior: Delimiter style may normalize within edited text (underscore → asterisk)
manifest.justification: PM emits asterisk delimiters; underscores are accepted on input but normalized on output
manifest.user_visible: Underscore emphasis becomes asterisks after editing that text

manifest.behavior: Byte-splice editing: only the edited field changes; all other fields and formatting preserved verbatim
manifest.justification: Structured editor edits one field via byte splice; never re-serializes the whole block
manifest.user_visible: Editing one front-matter field leaves all others byte-identical
